Booking terms

Photography and video consent

Last updated: 15 November 2026

Coaching video

Video is a big part of how we coach. We film every session from the coach boat and use it for debriefs, analysis and your post-camp summary. This filming is part of the coaching, so it happens for every sailor. Coaching footage is only shared with the sailor and their parents or guardians, and the group during debriefs.

Photos and video for promotion

We would love to use some photos and clips on this website and our social media. We only do this if you have given image consent on the medical and image release form. You can change your mind at any time, and we will stop using new images and take down what we reasonably can.

  • We never publish a sailor’s full name next to a photo without permission.
  • We never publish anything that shows a sailor in a way they or their parents wouldn’t be happy with. If you spot one, tell us and we will take it down.

Parents and spectators

Parents are welcome to take photos of their own sailor. Please don’t post close-ups of other children without their parents’ permission.

How long we keep it

Coaching video is kept until 12 months after the end of the series, unless you ask us to delete it sooner. See our privacy notice.

Changing your choice

Reply to any booking email or message us on WhatsApp.
